Resolves #20605

Adds two overridable hooks on `Neo.draggable.container.SortZone` so container subclasses with non-sortable siblings in flow (or sub-node drag proxies) can reuse `SortZone` without copying its `onDragStart` / `processDragEnd` lifecycle:

1. `getPinnedItems(ownerItems=this.owner.items, sortableItems=this.sortableItems)` — returns the item set measured, pinned (`position: 'absolute'`), and restored across `onDragStart` and `processDragEnd` while keeping `sortableItems` and `itemRects` scoped to the sortable items. Must contain every entry in `sortableItems` in `owner.items` order. Defaults to `sortableItems`.
2. `getDragElement(draggedItem, handleNode=null)` — returns the VDOM root cloned into the drag proxy for `draggedItem`, where `handleNode` is the matched drag handle VDOM node resolved from `owner.vdom` when `dragHandleSelector` is active. Defaults to `VDomUtil.find(this.owner.vdom, draggedItem.id).vdom`.

Evidence: L2 (automated unit tests in `test/playwright/unit/draggable/container/SortZone.spec.mjs` cover all ACs).

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the baseline jobs run in CI.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Verification |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `SortZone#getPinnedItems(ownerItems, sortableItems)` defaults to `sortableItems`; overriding it measures, pins (`position: 'absolute'`), and restores the returned item set across `onDragStart` and `processDragEnd` while keeping `sortableItems` and `itemRects` limited to `sortableItems` (`test/playwright/unit/draggable/container/SortZone.spec.mjs`). |
| AC-2 | `SortZone#getDragElement(draggedItem, handleNode)` defaults to `VDomUtil.find(this.owner.vdom, draggedItem.id).vdom` and receives `(draggedItem, handleNode)` where `handleNode` is resolved from `owner.vdom` when `dragHandleSelector` matches a `DomEvents#getTargetData` path descriptor (`test/playwright/unit/draggable/container/SortZone.spec.mjs`). |

### 📋 Required Actions

To proceed with merging, please address the following:

- [ ] **RA-1: make `getDragElement`'s `handleNode` contract true, and test it in the production shape.** `handleNode` is the `data.path` entry that matched `dragHandleSelector`, a `DomEvents#getTargetData` descriptor, but the JSDoc types it as "the matched drag handle VDOM node". The descriptor carries `tagName` and a cssText `style` and has no `cn`. `DragZone#getDragProxyVdom` clones whatever `dragElement` is as the proxy's VDOM, so an override that returns `handleNode` (the spec's own pattern) hands the proxy a descriptor. Either resolve before the call (`handleNode && VDomUtil.find(owner.vdom, handleNode.id)?.vdom`, which is what AC-2 promises) or keep the descriptor and document it with the resolution. Either way, the spec's path entry must be a descriptor distinct from `btnA.vdom.cn[0]`, so the assertion fails on the production shape.
- [ ] **RA-2: state `getPinnedItems`'s invariant in its JSDoc and in the ticket's ledger row.** The returned set must contain every sortable item, in owner order. `sortableItems.map(item => pinnedRects[pinnedItems.indexOf(item)])` turns an omitted sortable item into an `undefined` rect, which throws as soon as the drag reaches that item (`getSwitchExtent` and `switchItems` read its rect). The owner extent reads `pinnedRects[0]` and the last entry, so an out-of-order set mis-sizes the owner.
